verdict.rationale: Docs confirm employees self-enroll and Justworks collects W-4 filing/withholding info directly so they don't need to file a W-4 themselves, and general onboarding timelines (2-3 weeks) are documented. However, no evidence explicitly confirms I-9 collection or bank/direct-deposit detail collection as part of a unified self-serve pre-day-one flow. Missing for 10: explicit I-9 collection/verification workflow, explicit bank account/direct deposit setup step, and confirmation these are bundled into one onboarding flow before day one.
